entities.summary: Independence and the Rise of Francia, a transformative movement in Paraguay (1811–1840). Emerged from Radical isolationism: foreign trade and emigration banned and Paraguayan independence — May 14–15, 1811. Catalyzed Francia becomes 'El Supremo' — 1814, rules until 1840 and Carlos Antonio López opens Paraguay to foreign trade — 1840s.
